title: Lior and the Contact
author: Ada Brightwater
blurb: Odile Sterling, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
